body: S38-06: phys_respawn now zeros accumulated_reward after evolve_bot so each life competes on its own merit — previously oldest bot always won selection. S38-07: katana_apply_damage now sets target->hit_feedback=15 on every damage application so w_repel fires on incoming hits (evasion) not just outgoing hits (attacker confirmation).
title: S38-06+07: evolution reward reset + hit_feedback defender fix
